title: UA-Bench: Benchmarking Large Audio-Language Models on Underwater Acoustic Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.16942v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) are fast becoming a general interface to sound, yet how far their broad pretraining carries into specialized domains remains largely open. Vessel monitoring, maritime safety, and ocean sensing all depend on recognizing underwater signals, but to our knowledge LALMs have not been systematically evaluated on them. Annotated recordings are costly to collect, and a faithful synthetic alternative has to bring together many interacting factors: the structure of detection pulses, communication waveforms, and ship-radiated noise, and the sound-speed profile, geometry, and multipath propagation through which each reaches the receiver. We address this by proposing \textbf{UA-Bench}, to our knowledge the first large-scale benchmark for evaluating LALMs on underwater acoustic signal recognition. translated_title: UA-Bench：面向水声识别的大型音频-语言模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）正迅速成为声音的通用接口，但其广泛的预训练能在多大程度上迁移到专业领域，目前仍是一个基本悬而未决的问题。船舶监控、海事安全和海洋感知都依赖于对水下信号的识别，但据我们所知，LALMs尚未在这些任务上得到系统性评估。标注录音的采集成本高昂，而一个忠实的合成替代方案必须综合诸多相互作用的因素：探测脉冲、通信波形和船舶辐射噪声的结构，以及声速剖面、几何条件和多径传播等每种信号到达接收器的途径。我们通过提出UA-Bench来解决这一问题，据我们所知，这是首个用于评估LALMs水声信号识别能力的大规模基准。它包含375,051条音频记录，将参数化声源与建模的传播过程相结合，使每条记录都能……（原文此处被截断）
tldr: 提出UA-Bench——首个评估大型音频-语言模型水声信号识别能力的大规模基准，包含37.5万余条将参数化声源与建模传播相结合的音频记录。
en_tdlr: Proposes UA-Bench, the first large-scale benchmark for evaluating large audio-language models on underwater acoustic signal recognition, comprising 375,051 audio records that couple parameterized sources with modeled propagation.
